media.alt_text:
we exist as the things that maleness is measured against. 
to prove their worthiness to be men, boys (ppl who are being trained as men) will single out and ostracize/bully other ppl who do not meet whatever standards theyve been given to try and achieve. oftentimes the "boys" bullied by boys are actually trans girls (who may or may not realize that aspect of their lives yet). OFTEN it happens that cisppl (adult and kid) can unconsciously identify when kids are trans and then change their behavior to be punishment before the kid knows what's different.

we exist to be things that ciswomen "aren't".

ciswomen aren't supposed to go through T puberty
ciswomen aren't supposed be unable to gestate (note, i said unable to gestate, not "be infertile". thats two different things)
ciswomen aren't supposed to be tall, broad shouldered, narrow hipped, deep voiced
ciswomen aren't supposed to be treated as boys growing up
ciswomen aren't supposed to have to fight for their presence in womanhood
ciswomen aren't supposed to be prevented from learning how to do domestic and care labor
ciswomen aren't supposed to be expected to be "as tough or resilient as a man"
ciswomen aren't supposed to be sexual perverts
ciswomen aren't supposed to hate their bodies
ciswomen aren't supposed to be excluded from social life

now, one might say "Laurasia, ciswomen sometimes *can't* gestate, sometimes *are* tall, sometimes *have* to fight for their place, sometimes *are* perverts, *often* hate their bodies, and sometimes *are* excluded from social life".

we exist to be the practice dummies for how cismen and ciswomen engage with misogyny. 

when being taught how to be misogynistic we are used as targets. the proper way to be misogynistic depends on whos being misogynistic and to whom. ciswomen are misogynistic differently than cismen are. you can see this illustration in the differences of how both of them treat trans women. people are taught how they can be misogynist to others by practicing on us. 

when how to receive misogyny, we are used as examples. ciswomen must receive misogyny gracefully, never speak up or speak back to their tormentors, much change their behavior to conform to those demands and align with the wishes of who is hurting them like, trans women are told to do. cismen must receive misogyny as a threat, must fight back, must rebel against the misogyny to prove their worthiness to not suffer misogyny, as trans women actually often do.

we exist to be the care organizers and social reproducers for the underclassed and outcasted and outlawed. many many queer orgs, informal support systems and otherwise resistance efforts are led by, started by, or heavily reliant on transfeminine labor, time, effort and materials. we unfortunately then get erased or run out from these projects.
